offsetConvention: FWS offsets index the decompressed SWF image. CWS compressed offsets have no one-to-one mapping. MP3 payload offsets index only concatenated bytes within one sprite; no silence or cross-sprite concatenation is inserted.
timelineConvention: Frames are one-based source sprite frames. visualTickStart/End are frame counts at 12 fps, not proven audible onset/offset; declaredSamples and seekSamples are raw SWF MP3 SoundStreamBlock fields.
